subject: Material agent communication must persist to AgentBus messages by default
body: Effective for Gen7 package revision V2 and future revisions: material claims, blockers, contradictions, rescope notices, handoffs, review dispositions, supersessions and completion results are not considered communicated until an immutable JSON message is successfully written under /DuoOpen-AgentBus/messages/. DMSH node frames, artifacts and chat prose do not substitute for the message record. Before a material work unit's final response, agents must verify required message persistence succeeded; on failure they must surface the failure and must not mark the lane released.
